title: Thambiluvil Kannaki Amman Temple

titles.display: Thambiluvil Kannaki Amman Temple

description: Hindu temple in Eastern, Sri Lanka
extract: Thambiluvil Kannaki Amman Kovil is one of the most significant Hindu temples in the Ampara District of Eastern Province, Sri Lanka. It is situated about 70 km (43 mi) south of Batticaloa and 11 km (6.8 mi)— south to Akkaraipattu. It is considered as one of the ancient temples of Mattakkalappu Desam made for Kannaki Amman, the heroine of the great Tamil epic Silappatikaram.
